# Lua Modules

[Shared Lua modules for Quarto extensions: string, metadata, paths, HTML, and schema checks.]{.atelier-lead}

Your filter or shortcode needs the same helpers as every other extension.
It must escape text for HTML or Typst, read a setting from the metadata, resolve a path, or check a shortcode call against its schema.
Each extension writes these helpers again, or copies them from another extension.
These modules are tested once, and you copy the ones you use.

## Installation

Quarto has no package manager for Lua.
Copy the modules you need into `_vendor/quarto-lua-modules/` in your extension, and commit them.
The [vendoring guide](vendoring.qmd) covers the copy, the `_dependencies.yml` manifest, and how to update to a new release.

## Quick start

Copy `string.lua` into your extension, then load it from a filter:

```lua
local str = require(quarto.utils.resolve_path('_vendor/quarto-lua-modules/string.lua'):gsub('%.lua$', ''))
print(str.escape_html('Hello <World>'))
```

The output is `Hello &lt;World&gt;`.
